sn12.10:1.1: me bhikkhave sambodhā anabhisambuddhassa bodhisattasseva sato etad ahosi || ||
sn12.10:1.2: Kiccham vatāyaṃ loko āpanno jāyati ca jīyati ca mīyati ca cavati ca upapajjati ca ||
sn12.10:1.3: Atha ca pan' imassa dukkhassa nissaraṇam nappajānāti jarāmaraṇassa ||
sn12.10:1.4: Kudassu nāma imassa dukkhassa nissaraṇaṃ paññāyissati jarāmaraṇassāti || || 3
sn12.10:2.2: Kimhi nu kho sati jarāmaraṇaṃ hoti kimpaccayā jarāmaraṇanti || ||
sn12.10:2.3: Tassa mayhaṃ bhikkhave yoniso manasikārā ahu paññāya abhisamayo ||
sn12.10:2.4: jātiyā kho sati jarāmaraṇaṃ hoti jātipaccayā jarāmaraṇan ti || || 4-13
sn12.10:3.2: Kimhi nu kho sati jāti hoti ||
sn12.10:3.12: Tassa mayhaṃ bhikkhave yoniso manasikārā ahu paññāya abhisamayo ||
sn12.10:3.13: avijjāya kho sati saṅkhārā honti avijjā paccayā saṅkhārāti || || 14
sn12.10:4.3: Evam etassa kevalassa dukkhakkhandhassa samudayo hoti || 15
sn12.10:4.4: Samudayo samudayo ti kho me bhikkhave pubbe ananussutesu dhammesu cakkhum udapādi ñāṇam udapādi paññā udapādi vijjā udapādi āloko udapādi || || 16
sn12.10:5.2: Kimhi nu kho asati jarāmaraṇaṃ na hoti kissa nirodhā jarāmaraṇa nirodhoti || ||
sn12.10:5.3: Tassa mayham bhikkhave yoniso manasikārā ahu paññāya abhisamayo ||
sn12.10:5.4: jātiyā kho asati jarāmaraṇaṃ na hoti jātinirodhā jarāmaraṇanirodhoti || || 17-26
sn12.10:6.2: Kimhi nu kho asati jāti na hoti ||
sn12.10:6.11: saṅkhārā na honti || kissa nirodhā saṅkhāranirodho ti ||
sn12.10:6.12: Tassa mayham bhikkhave yoniso manasikārā ahu paññāya abhisamayo ||
sn12.10:6.13: Avijjāya kho asati saṅkhārā na honti avijjānirodhā saṅkhāranirodho ti || || 27
sn12.10:7.3: Evam etassa kevalassa dukkhakkhandhassa nirodho hoti || || 28.
sn12.10:7.4: Nirodho nirodhoti kho me bhikkhave pubbe ananussutesu dhammesu cakkhum udapādi ñāṇam udapādi paññā udapādi vijjā udapādi āloko udapādī ti || ||
